about.title: About
about.subtitle: Background & Experience
about.bio:
I'm an AI Engineer specializing in designing and deploying production-grade cognitive architectures — from advanced RAG pipelines to autonomous multi-agent workflows.

As a Senior AI Engineer at Solvefy, I'm deepening my expertise in Agentic AI, building systems capable of complex reasoning and autonomous task execution that go beyond simple API calls.

Before that, at Essentia Group, I architected intelligent patient support assistants using RAG and Vector Databases, and designed APIs that orchestrate LLMs, proprietary databases, and legacy systems with a focus on low latency and hallucination resistance.

My stack centers around Python, Node.js, LangChain, LangGraph, FastAPI, and AWS. I own the full lifecycle of an AI system: data ingestion, chunking strategy, retrieval evaluation, prompt design, observability, and production deployment.

Currently based in Florianópolis, Brazil, building AI systems that are not just technically advanced, but highly performant and secure for global production environments.
